title: Beach Haven | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched along the shimmering shores of Lake Tahoe, Beach Haven is a serene lakefront retreat that blends timeless comfort with understated luxury. This three-bedroom, two-bathroom home, complete with a private guest house, offers panoramic lake views and exclusive access to a sandy beach—just minutes from the heart of Kings Beach. Inside, the light-filled living area showcases expansive picture windows, high-end furnishings, and a wood-burning fireplace, all designed to frame and enhance the natural beauty beyond. A spacious deck invites effortless outdoor living, with lounge seating and dining spaces perfect for sun-soaked afternoons or starlit dinners by the water. The home’s interiors reflect thoughtful design and easy elegance, from the marble-countered kitchen to the cozy, stylish bedrooms furnished with plush linens and curated details. The detached guest house adds flexibility and privacy, ideal for extended family or friends. Whether enjoying a peaceful paddle along the shore, strolling to nearby restaurants, or gathering for a meal with the lake as your backdrop, Beach Haven offers a rare combination of tranquility, comfort, and access. It’s a refined yet relaxed escape where every moment feels connected to the stunning landscape of North Lake Tahoe.
